reviews.text: Excellent service, I loved it, I recommend it.

We rescued a puppy and took him to Calvet and received excellent care. The staff are super friendly, the bath is wonderful, and best of all 💗
Dr. Camila is excellent!
My puppy Dom loves Aunt Camila and Calvet. We're getting all his vaccinations done at the clinic, and the price is very good.
Congratulations Calvet, the service is 5 stars 🌟
I really liked the service I received from Dr. Gabriela.

I thought it was expensive; the consultation is affordable, but the other services offered aren't. I found the veterinarian a bit curt in her service, very much the "time is money" type, even though the clinic was empty.
